rows.meaning: in some way; by some means
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when the speaker means the task must be done one way or another.

example.english: We have to finish it before tonight somehow.
example.traditional: 我哋點都要喺今晚之前完成。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dim2 dou1 jiu3 hai2 gam1 maan5 zi1 cin4 jyun4 sing4

rows.meaning: in some way; by some means
rows.note: Use this when the focus is on achieving something by whatever method is available.

example.english: I have to get this report done somehow.
example.traditional: 呢份報告我點樣都要整掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 dou1 jiu3 zing2 dim6

rows.meaning: in some way; by some means
rows.note: Use this when the way something happened or will be done is unknown or left unexplained.

example.traditional: 唔知點樣，佢竟然搵到我屋企。
example.jyutping: m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 keoi5 ging2 jin4 wan2 dou2 ngo5 uk1 kei2
